results: MOBILE_SHADER_SLOTS 14 shader variants drawn and read back

scope: Private engineering builds; no release publication. Final pacing runs have no per-frame script instrumentation. Held and live measurements are separate.

visual_comparisons.metric: mean absolute RGB byte difference; live foliage/shadows make these non-bitwise comparisons
visual_comparisons.cache_control_crop_mae: less than one RGB byte per channel on average (Gipat)

limitations: Only one Android device measured. The issue #3 Adreno 840 hardware was not available.
Held scenes are camera/render diagnostics with live presentation, not complete gameplay benchmarks.
Live runs progress at different simulation rates; baseline advances 7.7–8.0 simulated seconds per 10-second window, candidate about 10.1–10.2. Do not treat these as deterministic matched workloads.
Initial profiler runs and shader ablations are diagnostic only. Broken or slower prototypes were not retained.
Desktop timings are not used for performance claims; desktop rendering was used as a colour reference.
repetition: Candidate held route, clean baseline held route, then a second candidate held route; same options, resolution and route. Repeat candidate: 10.96 / 9.94 / 9.96 FPS.
source_provenance: Both APKs use the recorded base and shipping native libraries. The baseline restores base game sources; the candidate applies the production files identified by production_file_sha256. workspace_diff_sha256_at_build describes the tracked working-copy diff when the helper ran, not the complete packaged source; it excludes untracked files and is also recorded before the baseline reset.
